messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: planning a daylight kernel/quant cutover for runtime-engine today at 11:30 PT. want to confirm smoke, canary slice, and rollback playbook.

deploybot: auto: scheduling pin: runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321 -> region-us-west-2. initial pin TTL=6h.

Tom: fyi last time we had a subtle kv-prefetch regression after quant param tweak. propose small canary 3/60 and an extended smoke run.

Nikhil: agree 3/60. smoke pass checks: p50/p95, inference.errors.rate, kv-prefetch-rate. abort if p95 > baseline+50ms OR errors > 1% sustained for 2 mins.

Rae: add mem-pressure watch. If resident memory per worker increases >20% vs baseline for 3 consecutive mins, capture heap and rollback. command: `capture_heap --pid $(pgrep runtime-engine) --out /tmp/heap-<ts>.dmp`

Aisha: Draft release note: "runtime-engine v3.0.2-qk: quantization updates and matmul micro-kernel improvements; expected tail latency reduction for ~8k token sessions. Daylight canary, contact #eng-runtime for regressions."

deploybot: canary started -> slice 3/60 on runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321. telemetry: https://telemetry.company/canary/1768301234

Tom: running local smoke:
```
./smoke.sh --engine runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321 --checks p50,p95,kv_prefetch,mem --duration 6m
```
ran on one host, p50 +4ms, p95 +22ms, mem steady.

Nikhil: tightening alert `quant-daylight-kv-spike` to 2m window. If it fires, we unpin immediately.

Aisha: thinking TTL=24h once canary stable so we don't auto-clear mid-investigation. any objections?

Rae: +1 TTL=24h. but manual unpin should be a single command in ops channel to avoid accidental clears.

deploybot: pin updated: runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321 pinned in region-us-west-2 by Aisha, TTL=24h.

deploybot: canary update after 10m: steady state reached. p50 delta +5ms, p95 delta +18ms, errors 0.3%. kv-prefetch +35% (expected). no alerts.

Tom: Good. i'll watch the p95 and kv prefetch for the next 10m then ramp to 25% if no noise.

Nikhil: Rollback procedure (automated): 1) deploybot unpin -> runtime-engine@v3.0.1-stable, 2) drain traffic from affected slices, 3) tag failing build `qk-20260321-failed`, 4) open postmortem stub and assign. Manual steps: oncall confirm and execute if needed.

Aisha: Capture checklist if we see regression: stack traces, heap dump, L3 occupancy, perf counters for matmul. Put artifacts in /artifacts/eng-runtime/1768301234.

oncall: noted. i'll be reachable during daylight window. prefer TTL=24h as well.

deploybot: scheduled ramp to 25% in +15m unless abort.

Rae: small note: keep the eval harness hot for any subtle quality diffs on long-context outputs. link: https://ci.company/evals/quant-daylight/20260321

Tom: thanks all. pinging support and sales with the release note now. will post a short post-deploy summary in ~1h.

deploybot: final: runtime-engine@v3.0.2-qk-20260321 pinned TTL=24h; canary stable; next action -> ramp to 25% at scheduled time unless manual abort.

Aisha: thanks team. thumbs up if you are monitoring. :thumbsup:
